summary: Tent camp below Vance Mountain (also called Vance Point), Idaho County, Idaho: used in the 1930s, now abandoned; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Camp abandoned; no source describes what remains at the site.

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts: tools on the western point, tent camp below the summit, 1930s
evidence.quote: The fire detection tools were located atop the western point, the tent camp below the summit.

evidence.supports: firelookout: 16 miles NNE of Magruder Ranger Station
Idaho Fire Lookouts: camp on westernmost point
evidence.quote: Camp was on the weternmost point

evidence.supports: Forest Service list: camp on the western most point
Forest Service list: 16 miles NNE of Magruder R.S.
Forest Service list: Vance Point row, 1930s, abandoned
FFLA county list: Vance Point, Idaho County, camp abandoned

notes_for_editor: Name: the record uses Vance Mountain (Forest Lookouts); firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts, the Forest Service list and the FFLA list all say Vance Point. Placement differs: Forest Lookouts puts the tools on the western point with the tent camp below the summit; the other three put the camp on the westernmost point. No dated event beyond the 1930s, so no events were written. Record point (45.91186, -114.4937) is about 5 km from the point the FFLA list and firelookout.com give (45.90006, -114.55882); the camp-below-summit detail may explain it, but no correction is proposed. Elevation 6,800 ft (about 2,073 m) is on two pages; record elevation_m is null and could be filled. A photo on the Forest Lookouts page is credited to a 1931 Bitterroot NF collection with permission required; not added.
